cucinaPage.metaDescription: Scirocco cuisine — territory, sea and contemporary Salento tradition.
cucinaPage.philoTitle: A cuisine born from the territory
cucinaPage.philoCopy: The Mediterranean is our starting point. Local produce, seasonality and contemporary technique shape an essential, authentic cuisine deeply rooted in Salento.
cucinaPage.territoryCopy: Fish from the Adriatic and Ionian seas, vegetables, olive oil, grains and local produce. A generous territory that inspires us every day and lives through our dishes.
cucinaPage.seaCopy: Fresh fish, shellfish and molluscs. The Mediterranean, every day.
cucinaPage.landCopy: Seasonal vegetables, olive oil, grains and the finest local produce.
cucinaPage.ctaCopy: Our cuisine changes with the sea and the seasons.

marePage.philoTitle: Respect, seasonality and quality of the catch.
marePage.philoCopy: We work with Mediterranean seafood, selecting the best ingredients according to season, availability and quality. The sea changes, and our cooking follows it.
marePage.speciesNote: An indicative selection: availability and origin change with the season and the market.
marePage.rawCopy: Tartare, carpaccio, shellfish, oysters and selected fish. Our raw preparations put quality, freshness and careful handling first, with proper food-safety procedures and cold-chain management.
marePage.ionio: Fish and shellfish, according to season and availability.
marePage.adriatico: Fish, molluscs and local-market selections when available.
marePage.mediterraneo: Selections chosen whenever quality and seasonality call for them.
marePage.methodKitchenCopy: Contemporary technique while keeping the product recognizable.
marePage.ctaTitle: Discover all our seafood dishes on the menu.
